# TagFusion

> TagFusion is a hand-picked directory of 146 independent websites, browsed by broad categories and combinable tags.

## Public pages

- [Explore the directory](https://halfhumandraft.com/): Browse the catalog and combine tags.
- [Search the directory](https://halfhumandraft.com/search/): Search listings by name, description, category, or tag.
- [Field guide](https://halfhumandraft.com/field-guide/): How categories and tags work, and how to judge an unfamiliar website.
- [About TagFusion](https://halfhumandraft.com/about/): Who runs it, how suggestions are reviewed, and the editorial policy.
- [Contact](https://halfhumandraft.com/contact/): Suggest a website or report a listing.
- [Privacy policy](https://halfhumandraft.com/privacy/): The site has no accounts, cookies, or analytics.
- [Terms of use](https://halfhumandraft.com/terms/): The rules for using the directory.
- [Full catalog as JSON](https://halfhumandraft.com/catalog.json)

Listings are starting points, not endorsements or guarantees of external websites.
